description.value: You magnify the protective power of your shield, slamming it into the ground and causing it to grow into a wall up to 60 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1/4 inch thick. The wall is made of the same material as the locus and doesn't need to stand vertically, forming a straight line parallel to the shield's surface. If the wall would pass through a creature or object, the spell is lost. Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, is immune to critical hits and precision damage, and has the same Hardness, HP, and BT as the locus. Creatures can move through a section of the wall that's broken.

system.requirements: You're holding a shield, used as a locus.
